_comment: Gate 3 justifications. A block under 5 hits must either be reached more (fix the generator) or appear here with a reason. Matching is by file + start line + snippet prefix against the BASE router text.

rules.reason: The module body of a router file executes once per copy at import; it is not a handler block.
createProxyWriteRoutes / createRulingsRoutes run once per mounted app (full + bare deployment per variant), i.e. 2 times by construction; they are factories, not handler blocks.

blocks.reason: `req.body || {}` in the attachments handler: express.json and the route's own parser both always leave req.body as an object, so the right-hand side is unreachable through HTTP (the unparsed-body case would need the parser removed from the mount).
`req.body || {}` in suggest-dismissal: unreachable for the same reason (the global express.json always sets req.body).
`req.body || {}` in suggest-answer: unreachable for the same reason.
The `!decisionId` 400 in suggest-dismissal is dead: :decisionId is a path parameter and Express never matches an empty segment (research comment b0cbaeee section 6).
The `!decisionId` 400 in suggest-answer is dead for the same reason.
